Sets how fast a body moves, in meters per second.
@param entity The body.
@param x Along x (pitch for turning).
@param y Along y (yaw for turning).
@param z Along z (roll for turning).
@param global False (default): the numbers are in the space of the body. True: they are in the world.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
